ns2:course.label: Science Communication Skills
ns2:course.description: A successful career in scientific research, teaching and service requires tools and skills for communicating research. Students interested in going into science careers need to know how to write a competitive graduate school or job application, a thesis proposal for graduate research, a fellowship or grant proposal, and how to give a good scientific presentation. This course is designed to teach students these skills with targeted in and out of class exercises. 2 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: IB 203 or IB 271; AND one of the following: IB 299, IB 390, IB 490, or consent of instructor. Junior IB majors only.
